name: Synthetic (CR +1)
body:
Modeled off of existing entities, synthetic creatures are robotic replicas designed to live forever. Retaining the physical and mental attributes of their base yet keeping none of their inferiorities or vulnerabilities, a well-built synthetic is highly valued by soldiers and collectors alike.

Synthetic is an acquired template that can be applied to any creature with a Constitution score, hereafter referred to as the base creature. A synthetic creature uses all of the base creature’s statistics and special abilities except as noted here.

Challenge Rating: Same as the base creature +1. This can be reduced to +0 if a creature is given no * worth of robot upgrades

Type: The base creature’s type changes to construct, and it gains the robot subtype. The creature retains any subtypes that it had previously. The creatore may choose whether the granted robot subtype grants robot upgrades as normal for robot Hit Dice. Change all the creature’s racial Hit Dice to d10s. All Hit Dice derived from class levels remain unchanged. As a construct, a synthetic creature does not have a Constitution score, but it gains bonus hit points based on its size.

Ability Score Modifiers: If the base creature’s Intelligence score is less than 10, the creature’s Intelligence score becomes 10.

Feats: If a creature would lose the ability to use any feats it possesses as a result of its new type, it may exchange them for other feats, chosen by the creator, upon gaining this template.

Special Qualities: A synthetic creature gains the following special qualities:

Mimicry

A synthetic creature gains a +8 racial bonus to pass as the creature it is intended to replicate or the creature that it originally was.

Robot Upgrades

A synthetic creature gains a number of equal to its CR, allocated as the creator wishes among upgrades.

Weaknesses: A synthetic creature becomesvulnerable to critical hits and vulnerable to electricity weaknesses as the robot subtype.

Creating a Synthetic Creature

Creating a synthetic creature requires the craft robot feat, a robotics lab, and an amount of material worth 3,000 gp x the synthetic creature’s new CR. Instead of creating a new creature entirely, you may apply the synthetic template to an existing creature, which reduces the cost by half. The creator must attempt a Craft (mechanical) check with a DC of 20 + the synthetic creature’s new CR and must have ranks in Craft (mechanical) equal to the synthetic creature’s new CR.
